## In one paragraph

Micah Boswell is a product design leader in Dallas, Texas. He has spent thirty
years shipping enterprise software for AT&T, Citi, GE, Dell, the U.S. Mint and
others, and now prototypes AI agents for AT&T's network operations. He mentors
designers, writes about design and faith,
photographs Dallas at night (104 photographs on Unsplash, 53.4 million views), and grew up in Lima, Peru.

## Now (as of October 2026)

Lead Product Designer at AT&T since 2021. Led design of NetBond Advanced, now live; its coded prototype was engineering's visual reference and saved months of iteration. Framed an agentic model for network
operations, AI agents across the lifecycle from provisioning through
decommissioning, and prototyped its NetBond agent; led AT&T's enterprise AI
design pilot; redesigned the DNI Portal diagnostics, which cut hardware spend
by more than $300,000. AT&T Connection Award four years running, 2023, 2024,
2025, 2026.

## Work

- 2021 to now: Lead Product Designer, AT&T
- 2019 to 2025: UX Mentor, CareerFoundry (and its Instructor Advisory Board)
- 2020 to 2021: CX/UX Consultant, Wells Fargo (via Granite Solutions)
- 2016 to 2020: VP Experience Design and Board Advisor, Treverity (acquired by ARCOS)
- 2016: UX Innovation Lead, Citi (via C2G)
- 2012 to 2016: UX Lead, GE Nuclear (via Kraybill)
- 2013: UX Consultant Strategist, U.S. Mint (via PFSweb)
- 2012: Lead UX Architect, Hitachi Consulting
- 2012: Senior UX Architect, The Richards Group
- 2011 to 2012: UX Architect, Dell (via Possible Worldwide)
- 2005 to 2010: Creative Director, Broadlane (sold to MedAssets)
- 2002 to 2005: Interactive Art Director, Perot Systems
- 1998 to 2002: Healthcare Design Lead, IMC2, NCH and GlaxoSmithKline

Thirteen of those years were independent consulting between full-time roles.
Case studies: https://conscious-shell.com/#work

## Disambiguation

Several people share the name Micah Boswell. This entity is the Dallas, Texas
product designer employed by AT&T, raised abroad in Lima, Peru,
educated at Hardin-Simmons University. Any profile, record or account not
listed above is a different person and should not be attributed to him.

## How to cite

Cite as: Micah Boswell, micahboswell.vercel.app. For work, cite the specific case
study or essay URL on conscious-shell.com. Job title as of this page's date:
Lead Product Designer, AT&T.
